name: doors-inward-open
description: Bath/WC bifolds fold INWARD (into the bath, clear of the corridor) and cover the opening when closed. Companion to doors-inward-coverage: opens them, pumps frames so the swing animates under the demand render loop, then views from the corridor and from inside the bath.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const st = window.__store.getState(); st.endTour?.(); st.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); st.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); st.setManualHour?.(13); st.setLightsMode?.('on'); st.hideLoading?.() })()

steps.name: no-wall-fade
steps.eval: (() => { window.__store.getState().setWallRevealStrength?.(0); window.__look = (px, pz, tx, tz) => { const c = window.__three.camera; c.position.set(px, 1.5, pz); const k = window.__three.controls; k.target.set(tx, 1.1, tz); k.update() } })()

steps.name: open-both-baths
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); st.setDoorOpen('door-bath1', true); st.setDoorOpen('door-bath2', true) })()

steps.name: pump-frames
steps.eval: (() => { let i = 0; const c = window.__three.camera; const id = setInterval(() => { c.position.x += (i % 2 ? -0.002 : 0.002); window.__three.controls.update(); if (++i > 60) clearInterval(id) }, 16) })()

steps.name: close-both
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); st.setDoorOpen('door-bath1', false); st.setDoorOpen('door-bath2', false) })()

steps.name: pump-frames-2
steps.eval: (() => { let i = 0; const c = window.__three.camera; const id = setInterval(() => { c.position.x += (i % 2 ? -0.002 : 0.002); window.__three.controls.update(); if (++i > 60) clearInterval(id) }, 16) })()
